entries.title: It turns out that the peculiar way of conducting the experiments may have led to
entries.text: It turns out that the peculiar way of conducting the experiments may have led to 14 interpretations of what happened. [A] disputable 可争议的 [B] enlightening 有启发的 [C] reliable 可靠的 [D] misleading 误导性的 答案 D misleading It turns out that the peculiar way of conducting the experiments may have led to 14 interpretations of what happened. 15, lighting was always changed on a Sunday. When work started again on Monday, output 16 rose compared with the previous Saturday and 17 to rise for the next couple of days. 18, a comparison with data for weeks when there was no experimentation showed that output always went up on Mondays. Workers 19 to be diligent for the first few days of the week in any case, before 20 a plateau and then slackening off. This suggests that the alleged "Hawthorne effect" is hard to pin down. entries.title: It is indicated in Paragraphs 1 and 2 that ___.
entries.text: It is indicated in Paragraphs 1 and 2 that ___. [A] arts criticism has disappeared from big-city newspapers 艺术评论已从大都市报纸上消失 [B] English-language newspapers used to carry more arts reviews [C] high-quality newspapers retain a large body of readers 高质量报纸保有一大批读者 [D] young readers doubt the suitability of criticism on dailies 年轻读者怀疑日报评论的恰当性 答案 B It is indicated in Paragraphs 1 and 2 that ___.第 1 段和第 2 段表明___。 [A] arts criticism has disappeared from big-city newspapers艺术评论已从大都市报纸上消失 [B] English-language newspapers used to carry more arts reviews [C] high-quality newspapers retain a large body of readers高质量报纸保有一大批读者 [D] young readers doubt the suitability of criticism on dailies年轻读者怀疑日报评论的恰当性 💡 考场思路首段说 arts coverage 的 scope 和 seriousness 在 inexorable decline（不可阻挡地衰落），第二段说过去大城市报上能读到高质量评论——反推：过去报纸有更多艺术评论。 逐项分析 [A] 艺术评论已从大报消失 → 偷换，原文是 decline 不是 disappeared； [B] 英文报过去有更多艺术评论 → 正确，decline 反推过去更多； [C] 高质量报纸仍有大量读者 → 无中生有； [D] 年轻读者怀疑评论适合登日报 → 无中生有，原文是今天的人 marvel at。

entries.title: Newspaper reviews in England before World War II were characterized by ___.
entries.text: Newspaper reviews in England before World War II were characterized by ___. [A] free themes [B] casual style 随意的风格 [C] elaborate layout 精心设计的布局 [D] radical viewpoints 激进的观点 答案 A Newspaper reviews in England before World War II were characterized by ___.二战前英格兰的报纸评论以___为特征。 [A] free themes [B] casual style随意的风格 [C] elaborate layout精心设计的布局 [D] radical viewpoints激进的观点 💡 考场思路第三段首句 unfocused newspaper reviews = 没有固定焦点、主题自由的评论。unfocused ≈ free themes。 逐项分析 [A] 主题自由 → 正确，unfocused 同义替换； [B] 风格随意 → 与 serious business 相反； [C] 版面精美 → 偷换，原文说 stylish criticism 是 ornament 不是 layout； [D] 激进观点 → 无中生有。

entries.title: Which of the following would Shaw and Newman most probably agree on?
entries.text: Which of the following would Shaw and Newman most probably agree on? [A] It is writers' duty to fulfill journalistic goals. 实现新闻目标乃作家之责。 [B] It is contemptible for writers to be journalists. 作家充当记者是卑劣的。 [C] Writers are likely to be tempted into journalism. 作家很可能被诱惑进入新闻业。 [D] Not all writers are capable of journalistic writing. 答案 D Which of the following would Shaw and Newman most probably agree on?Shaw和Newman最有可能同意以下哪一项？ [A] It is writers' duty to fulfill journalistic goals.实现新闻目标乃作家之责。 [B] It is contemptible for writers to be journalists.作家充当记者是卑劣的。 [C] Writers are likely to be tempted into journalism.作家很可能被诱惑进入新闻业。 [D] Not all writers are capable of journalistic writing. 💡 考场思路纽曼原话："So few authors have brains enough or literary gift enough to keep their own end up in journalism"——有足够头脑和天赋把新闻做好的作家太少。= 并非所有作家都能胜任新闻写作。

entries.title: What can be learned about Cardus according to the last two paragraphs?
entries.text: What can be learned about Cardus according to the last two paragraphs? [A] His music criticism may not appeal to readers today. [B] His reputation as a music critic has long been in dispute. 他作为乐评人的声誉长期存在争议。 [C] His style caters largely to modern specialists. 他的风格主要迎合现代专家。 [D] His writings fail to follow the amateur tradition. 他的著作未能遵循业余传统。 答案 A What can be learned about Cardus according to the last two paragraphs?根据最后两段，关于Cardus可以学到什么？ [A] His music criticism may not appeal to readers today. [B] His reputation as a music critic has long been in dispute.他作为乐评人的声誉长期存在争议。 [C] His style caters largely to modern specialists.他的风格主要迎合现代专家。 [D] His writings fail to follow the amateur tradition.他的著作未能遵循业余传统。 💡 考场思路最后一段：postmodern readers have little use for the richly upholstered prose he specialized in——后现代读者对他的华丽文风不感兴趣。= 他的音乐评论可能对今天的读者没有吸引力。

entries.title: What would be the best title for the text?
entries.text: What would be the best title for the text? [A] Newspapers of the Good Old Days 昔日美好的报纸 [B] The Lost Horizon in Newspapers [C] Mournful Decline of Journalism 新闻业的哀歌式衰落 [D] Prominent Critics in Memory 记忆中的著名批评家 答案 B What would be the best title for the text?这篇文章的最佳标题是什么？ [A] Newspapers of the Good Old Days昔日美好的报纸 [B] The Lost Horizon in Newspapers [C] Mournful Decline of Journalism新闻业的哀歌式衰落 [D] Prominent Critics in Memory记忆中的著名批评家 💡 考场思路全文讲报纸艺术评论衰落、评论家被遗忘。B"报纸中逝去的地平线"既指过去的辉煌又指失落，最贴合。C范围过大（全文只讲 arts criticism，不是整个 journalism）。 核心词汇 inexorable adj. 不可阻挡的 coverage n. 新闻报道 marvel at 惊叹 deem v. 认为 calling n. 使命/职业 upholstered adj. 辞藻华丽的 headlong retreat 急速衰落 save to 除……之外

entries.title: Business-method patents have recently aroused concern because of ___.
entries.text: Business-method patents have recently aroused concern because of ___. [A] their limited value to businesses. 它们对企业的有限价值。 [B] their connection with asset allocation. 它们与资产配置的关联。 [C] the possible restriction on their granting. [D] the controversy over their authorization. 围绕其授权的争议。 答案 C Business-method patents have recently aroused concern because of ___.商业方法专利最近因___而引起关注。 [A] their limited value to businesses.它们对企业的有限价值。 [B] their connection with asset allocation.它们与资产配置的关联。 [C] the possible restriction on their granting. [D] the controversy over their authorization.围绕其授权的争议。 💡 考场思路第二段首句 ready to scale back on business-method patents——准备缩减商业方法专利。scale back = restrict。题干 recently 对应 now。 逐项分析 [A] 对企业价值有限 → 与文中企业竞相申请相反； [B] 与资产配置相关 → 只是例子； [C] 授权可能受限 → 正确； [D] 授权争议 → 偷换，controversy 是10年来一直有，但 recently 引起关注是因为法院要限制。

entries.title: Which of the following is true of the Bilski case?
entries.text: Which of the following is true of the Bilski case? [A] Its ruling complies with the court decisions. 其裁决符合法院判决。 [B] It involves a very big business transaction. 它涉及一笔巨大的商业交易。 [C] It has been dismissed by the Federal Circuit. 它已被联邦巡回法院驳回。 [D] It may change the legal practices in the U.S. 答案 D Which of the following is true of the Bilski case?对于Bilski案，以下哪项是正确的？ [A] Its ruling complies with the court decisions.其裁决符合法院判决。 [B] It involves a very big business transaction.它涉及一笔巨大的商业交易。 [C] It has been dismissed by the Federal Circuit.它已被联邦巡回法院驳回。 [D] It may change the legal practices in the U.S. 💡 考场思路第二段说 It has the potential to eliminate an entire class of patents——可能撤销一整类专利，即改变美国法律实践。

entries.title: The word "about-face" (Para. 3) most probably means ___.
entries.text: The word "about-face" (Para. 3) most probably means ___. [A] loss of goodwill. 商誉的损失。 [B] increase of hostility. 敌意的增强。 [C] change of attitude. [D] enhancement of dignity. 尊严的提升。 答案 C The word "about-face" (Para. 3) most probably means ___.“about-face”（第 3 段）一词最可能的意思是___。 [A] loss of goodwill.商誉的损失。 [B] increase of hostility.敌意的增强。 [C] change of attitude. [D] enhancement of dignity.尊严的提升。 💡 考场思路about-face 原义"向后转"。联邦巡回法院1998年引入这类专利，现在又要限制——态度180度大转弯。

entries.title: We learn from the last two paragraphs that business-method patents ___.
entries.text: We learn from the last two paragraphs that business-method patents ___. [A] are immune to legal challenges. 不受法律挑战影响。 [B] are often unnecessarily issued. [C] lower the esteem for patent holders. 降低对专利持有人的尊重。 [D] increase the incidence of risks. 增加风险发生的几率。 答案 B We learn from the last two paragraphs that business-method patents ___.我们从最后两段中了解到，商业方法专利___。 [A] are immune to legal challenges.不受法律挑战影响。 [B] are often unnecessarily issued. [C] lower the esteem for patent holders.降低对专利持有人的尊重。 [D] increase the incidence of risks.增加风险发生的几率。 💡 考场思路最后一段：too many patents were being upheld for "inventions" that are obvious——太多显而易见的"发明"被授予专利。= 很多专利其实不该发。

entries.title: Which of the following would be the subject of the text?
entries.text: Which of the following would be the subject of the text? [A] A looming threat to business-method patents. [B] Protection for business-method patent holders. 对商业方法专利持有人的保护。 [C] A legal case regarding business-method patents. 一起关于商业方法专利的诉讼。 [D] A prevailing trend against business-method patents. 反对商业方法专利的一种普遍趋势。 答案 A Which of the following would be the subject of the text?以下哪一项是本文的主题？ [A] A looming threat to business-method patents. [B] Protection for business-method patent holders.对商业方法专利持有人的保护。 [C] A legal case regarding business-method patents.一起关于商业方法专利的诉讼。 [D] A prevailing trend against business-method patents.反对商业方法专利的一种普遍趋势。 💡 考场思路全文讲法院准备缩减商业方法专利，这是"即将到来的威胁"。注意D说 prevailing trend（已盛行），但文章说法院刚要行动、威胁尚未完全落地，looming（隐约逼近）更准。 核心词汇 patent n. 专利 scale back 缩减 controversial adj. 有争议的 authorize v. 授权 eliminate v. 消除 about-face n. 大转弯 stake out 主张/声称 hedge risk 对冲风险

entries.title: By citing the book The Tipping Point, the author intends to ___.
entries.text: By citing the book The Tipping Point, the author intends to ___. [A] analyze the consequences of social epidemics. 分析社会流行的后果。 [B] discuss influentials' function in spreading ideas. [C] exemplify people's intuitive response to social epidemics. 例证人们对社会潮流的直觉反应。 [D] describe the essential characteristics of influentials. 描述有影响力者的本质特征。 答案 B By citing the book The Tipping Point, the author intends to ___.通过引用《引爆点》一书，作者打算___。 [A] analyze the consequences of social epidemics.分析社会流行的后果。 [B] discuss influentials' function in spreading ideas. [C] exemplify people's intuitive response to social epidemics.例证人们对社会潮流的直觉反应。 [D] describe the essential characteristics of influentials.描述有影响力者的本质特征。 💡 考场思路首段引用《引爆点》提出"有影响力者推动社会潮流"这一观点，然后全文讨论这个观点对不对。引用是为了引出有影响力者在传播观念中的作用这一话题。

entries.title: The author suggests that the "two-step-flow theory" ___.
entries.text: The author suggests that the "two-step-flow theory" ___. [A] serves as a solution to marketing problems. 充当营销难题的一种解决方案。 [B] has helped explain certain prevalent trends. 有助于解释某些流行趋势。 [C] has won support from influentials. 已赢得有影响力人士的支持。 [D] requires solid evidence for its validity. 答案 D The author suggests that the "two-step-flow theory" ___.作者提出“两步流理论” ___。 [A] serves as a solution to marketing problems.充当营销难题的一种解决方案。 [B] has helped explain certain prevalent trends.有助于解释某些流行趋势。 [C] has won support from influentials.已赢得有影响力人士的支持。 [D] requires solid evidence for its validity. 💡 考场思路第二段说该理论是 plausible-sounding but largely untested（听起来合理但基本未经验证），最后一句 anecdotal evidence（传闻证据）——暗示需要可靠证据。

entries.title: What the researchers have observed recently shows that ___.
entries.text: What the researchers have observed recently shows that ___. [A] the power of influence goes with social interactions. [B] interpersonal links can be enhanced through the media. 人际关系可通过媒体得到加强。 [C] influentials have more channels to reach the public. 有影响力者拥有更多触达公众的渠道。 [D] most celebrities enjoy wide media attention. 多数名人享有广泛的媒体关注。 答案 A What the researchers have observed recently shows that ___.研究人员最近观察到的情况表明___。 [A] the power of influence goes with social interactions. [B] interpersonal links can be enhanced through the media.人际关系可通过媒体得到加强。 [C] influentials have more channels to reach the public.有影响力者拥有更多触达公众的渠道。 [D] most celebrities enjoy wide media attention.多数名人享有广泛的媒体关注。 💡 考场思路研究发现潮流靠层层人际影响传播：每个人影响熟人，熟人再影响熟人。影响力伴随社会互动而传递。

entries.title: The underlined phrase "these people" in Paragraph 4 refers to the ones who ___.
entries.text: The underlined phrase "these people" in Paragraph 4 refers to the ones who ___. [A] stay outside the network of social influence. 置身于社会影响网络之外。 [B] have little contact with the source of influence. 与影响源几乎无接触。 [C] are influenced and then influence others. [D] are influenced by the initial influential. 受初始有影响力者的左右。 答案 C The underlined phrase "these people" in Paragraph 4 refers to the ones who ___.第4款中带下划线的短语“这些人”指的是___的人。 [A] stay outside the network of social influence.置身于社会影响网络之外。 [B] have little contact with the source of influence.与影响源几乎无接触。 [C] are influenced and then influence others. [D] are influenced by the initial influential.受初始有影响力者的左右。 💡 考场思路these people 指代前一句：each person so affected must then influence his or her own acquaintances, who must in turn influence theirs——那些被影响又反过来影响别人的人。

entries.title: What is the essential element in the dynamics of social influence?
entries.text: What is the essential element in the dynamics of social influence? [A] The eagerness to be accepted. 渴望被接纳。 [B] The impulse to influence others. 影响他人的冲动。 [C] The readiness to be influenced. [D] The inclination to rely on others. 依赖他人的倾向。 答案 C What is the essential element in the dynamics of social influence?社会影响力动态的基本要素是什么？ [A] The eagerness to be accepted.渴望被接纳。 [B] The impulse to influence others.影响他人的冲动。 [C] The readiness to be influenced. [D] The inclination to rely on others.依赖他人的倾向。 💡 考场思路末句：a critical mass of easily influenced people——一大批容易受影响的人。easily influenced = readiness to be influenced。 核心词汇 epidemic n. 流行病/潮流 influential n. 有影响力者 compelling adj. 令人信服的 plausible adj. 貌似合理的 cursory adj. 粗略的 cascade n. 连锁反应 propagate v. 传播 critical mass 临界数量

entries.title: Bankers complained that they were forced to ___.
entries.text: Bankers complained that they were forced to ___. [A] follow unfavorable asset evaluation rules. [B] collect payments from third parties. 向第三方收取费用。 [C] cooperate with the price managers. 与价格管理者合作。 [D] re-evaluate some of their assets. 重新评估其部分资产。 答案 A Bankers complained that they were forced to ___.银行家们抱怨说，他们被迫___。 [A] follow unfavorable asset evaluation rules. [B] collect payments from third parties.向第三方收取费用。 [C] cooperate with the price managers.与价格管理者合作。 [D] re-evaluate some of their assets.重新评估其部分资产。 💡 考场思路首段：准则迫使银行按第三方愿意支付的价格评估资产（price managers/regulators 想让它们按高价算），银行抱怨不公平。即被迫遵守不利的资产评估规则。

entries.title: According to the author, the rule changes of the FASB may result in ___.
entries.text: According to the author, the rule changes of the FASB may result in ___. [A] the diminishing role of management. 管理作用的弱化。 [B] the revival of the banking system. 银行体系的复苏。 [C] the banks' long-term asset losses. 银行的长期资产损失。 [D] the weakening of its independence. 答案 D According to the author, the rule changes of the FASB may result in ___.据作者称， FASB的规则变更可能会导致___。 [A] the diminishing role of management.管理作用的弱化。 [B] the revival of the banking system.银行体系的复苏。 [C] the banks' long-term asset losses.银行的长期资产损失。 [D] the weakening of its independence. 💡 考场思路第二段说准则制定者独立性正在受损；第三段FASB在国会压力下匆匆改规则——即独立性被削弱。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 4, McCreevy objects to the IASB's attempt to ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 4, McCreevy objects to the IASB's attempt to ___. [A] keep away from political influences. 远离政治影响。 [B] evade the pressure from rule-makers. 逃避规则制定者的压力。 [C] act on their own in rule-setting. [D] take gradual measures in reform. 在改革中采取渐进措施。 答案 C According to Paragraph 4, McCreevy objects to the IASB's attempt to ___.根据第4段， McCreevy反对国际会计准则理事会试图___。 [A] keep away from political influences.远离政治影响。 [B] evade the pressure from rule-makers.逃避规则制定者的压力。 [C] act on their own in rule-setting. [D] take gradual measures in reform.在改革中采取渐进措施。 💡 考场思路IASB想"在没有整体规划下不贸然行动"即按自己节奏独立行事；McCreevy警告它"不是生活在政治真空中"——反对它独断专行。

entries.title: The author thinks the banks were "on the wrong planet" in that they ___.
entries.text: The author thinks the banks were "on the wrong planet" in that they ___. [A] misinterpreted market price indicators. 误读了市场价格指标。 [B] exaggerated the real value of their assets. [C] neglected the likely existence of bad debts. 忽视了坏账可能存在。 [D] denied booking losses in their sale of assets. 否认在资产出售中存在账面亏损。 答案 B The author thinks the banks were "on the wrong planet" in that they ___.作者认为银行“在错误的星球上” ，因为他们___。 [A] misinterpreted market price indicators.误读了市场价格指标。 [B] exaggerated the real value of their assets. [C] neglected the likely existence of bad debts.忽视了坏账可能存在。 [D] denied booking losses in their sale of assets.否认在资产出售中存在账面亏损。 💡 考场思路第五段首句：It was banks that were on the wrong planet, with accounts that vastly overvalued assets——银行账目严重高估资产。overvalued = exaggerated the real value。

entries.title: The author's attitude towards standard-setters is one of ___.
entries.text: The author's attitude towards standard-setters is one of ___. [A] satisfaction. 满意；满足。 [B] skepticism. 怀疑；质疑。 [C] objectiveness. 客观。 [D] sympathy. 答案 D The author's attitude towards standard-setters is one of ___.作者对标准制定者的态度是___之一。 [A] satisfaction.满意；满足。 [B] skepticism.怀疑；质疑。 [C] objectiveness.客观。 [D] sympathy. 💡 考场思路末段说 successful markets require independent and even combative standard-setters，又说它们giving in to critics是在招致压力——作者同情被银行游说施压的准则制定者。 核心词汇 take aim at 瞄准/批评 moan v. 抱怨 compromise v. 损害 toxic assets 不良资产 illiquid adj. 非流动的 book value 账面价值 combative adj. 好斗的 concession n. 让步

entries.title: Scientists jumped to the rescue with some distinctly shaky evidence to the effec
entries.text: Scientists jumped to the rescue with some distinctly shaky evidence to the effect that insects would eat us up if birds failed to control them. Scientists jumped to the rescue with some distinctly shaky evidence to the effect that insects would eat us up if birds failed to control them. 科学家们急忙介入，但提出的证据显然站不住脚，其大意是：如果鸟类不能控制昆虫数量，昆虫便会吞噬我们人类。 采分点① jump to the rescue 急忙赶来救援（意译）；② distinctly shaky evidence 明显站不住脚的证据；③ to the effect that 大意是/意思是（固定短语，高频考点）。

entries.text: but we have at least drawn nearer the point of admitting that birds should continue as a matter of intrinsic right, regardless of the presence or absence of economic advantage to us. but we have at least drawn nearer the point of admitting that birds should continue as a matter of intrinsic right, regardless of the presence or absence of economic advantage to us. 但是我们至少已经近乎承认，鸟类无论对我们有无经济价值，都应继续生存下去，这是它们固有的权利。 采分点① draw nearer the point of 近乎/接近……这一步；② intrinsic right 固有权利；③ regardless of 不管；④ the presence or absence of 有无。

entries.title: Time was when biologists somewhat overworked the evidence that these creatures p
entries.text: Time was when biologists somewhat overworked the evidence that these creatures preserve the health of game by killing the physically weak, or that they prey only on "worthless" species. Time was when biologists somewhat overworked the evidence that these creatures preserve the health of game by killing the physically weak, or that they prey only on "worthless" species. 曾经有段时间，生物学家有点过重地使用了这样的证据：这些生物通过猎杀体弱的动物来保持猎物种群的健康，或者说它们捕食的只是"没有价值"的物种。 采分点① Time was when… 曾经有段时间（=There was a time when）；② overwork 过度使用；③ game 猎物（熟词僻义）；④ prey on 捕食。

entries.title: In Europe, where forestry is ecologically more advanced, the noncommercial tree
entries.text: In Europe, where forestry is ecologically more advanced, the noncommercial tree species are recognized as members of the native forest community, to be preserved as such, within reason. In Europe, where forestry is ecologically more advanced, the noncommercial tree species are recognized as members of the native forest community, to be preserved as such, within reason. 在欧洲，林业在生态上更为先进，那些没有商业价值的树种被视为原始森林群落的成员，因而受到相应的保护，而且是在合理范围之内。 采分点① ecologically more advanced 生态上更先进；② noncommercial 无商业价值的；③ as such 照此/本身；④ within reason 合理地。

entries.title: It tends to ignore, and thus eventually to eliminate, many elements in the land
entries.text: It tends to ignore, and thus eventually to eliminate, many elements in the land community that lack commercial value, but that are essential to its healthy functioning. It tends to ignore, and thus eventually to eliminate, many elements in the land community that lack commercial value, but that are essential to its healthy functioning. 这一体系往往会忽视并最终消灭陆地群落中许多缺乏商业价值、但对其健康运行却至关重要的物种。 采分点① tend to 往往；② eliminate 消灭；③ 两个that并列定语从句修饰elements，注意but转折；④ healthy functioning 健康运行。

entries.text: Suppose you are a member of the Postgraduates' Association. Write a notice to recruit volunteers for an international conference on globalization. The notice should include the basic qualifications of the applicants and other information you think relevant. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the notice. Use "Postgraduates' Association" instead. Part A 小作文（10分）— 招募志愿者通知 原题指令 Directions Suppose you are a member of the Postgraduates' Association. Write a notice to recruit volunteers for an international conference on globalization. The notice should include the basic qualifications of the applicants and other information you think relevant. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the notice. Use "Postgraduates' Association" instead. 【译文】假设你代表研究生会。写一则通知，为一场关于全球化的国际会议招募志愿者。通知应包含申请者的基本条件以及其他你认为相关的信息。字数约100词。通知末尾不要署自己的名字，使用“研究生会”落款。 题目 代表研究生会写一则通知，为一场关于全球化的国际会议招募志愿者。内容应包括申请者的基本资格以及其他你认为相关的信息。约100词，落款用"Postgraduates' Association"。 审题 ① 格式：通知（notice），标题居中，落款组织；② 内容：会议时间地点+招募条件（英语好、沟通能力、相关经验、时间充裕）+ 报名方式；③ 语气：正式但友好。 参考范文 Notice An International Conference on Globalization will be held on our campus from January 15 to 17. To ensure its smooth running, the Postgraduates' Association is now recruiting 30 volunteers. Ideal candidates should meet the following requirements. First and foremost, a good command of spoken English is essential, since most participants come from overseas. Second, those with previous volunteer experience will be given priority. entries.text: Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The drawing shows a hotpot in which various ingredients are boiling, with Chinese and foreign cultural symbols written on them, such as "Shenzhou", "Confucius", "Einstein", "Lao She", "Shakespeare", "deconstruction", "enlightenment", "humanism", "Buddhism", "Taoism", etc. The caption reads: Cultural "hotpot" — both delicious and nutritious. Part B 大作文（20分）— 文化"火锅"，既美味又营养 原题指令 Directions Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The drawing shows a hotpot in which various ingredients are boiling, with Chinese and foreign cultural symbols written on them, such as "Shenzhou", "Confucius", "Einstein", "Lao She", "Shakespeare", "deconstruction", "enlightenment", "humanism", "Buddhism", "Taoism", etc. The caption reads: Cultural "hotpot" — both delicious and nutritious. 【译文】根据 图画描述 图画中一个火锅里煮着许多食材，上面写着"Shenzhou""Confucius""Einstein""解构""天鹅湖""老舍""解构""启蒙""人本""行为""儒""道""佛""莎士比亚""后现代""网络"等中外文化符号。下方文字：文化"火锅"，既美味又营养。 审题框架 三段式：①简要描述图画（火锅里的中外文化元素）；②阐释寓意（文化融合是当今时代趋势，既美味又营养）；③给出评论（我们应欢迎文化交流、取精去糟）。160-200词。 参考范文 The vivid illustration portrays a simmering hotpot brimming with a rich assortment of cultural ingredients, ranging from Confucius and Shakespeare to postmodernism and Beijing Opera.
